result.title: OpenDepth: Repurposing Image Editing Priors for Robust Open-World Monocular Depth Estimation
result.comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026. 18 pages, 9 figures, including supplementary material
result.summary: Recently, the integration of generative priors has revolutionized Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE), achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkably high data efficiency. However, although methods based on Text-to-Image (T2I) models excel in general scenes, their efficacy degrades sharply when confronted with open-world environmental perturbations, such as illumination variations and adverse weather. Since T2I priors are optimized for semantic synthesis rather than preserving pixel-level structure, they struggle to decouple geometry from appearance under severe visual shifts, easily triggering structural hallucinations. Therefore, our core insight is to model open-world depth estimation as consistent geometric inference across multi-style images, fully leveraging the powerful structure-preserving editing priors of Image-to-Image (I2I) models. Based on this, we propose OpenDepth, a robust open-world MDE framework that introduces "Intra-Domain Awareness" -- the capability to map diverse stylistic inputs sharing identical geometry into a unified latent space. To achieve this, we first align shallow features within the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) to anchor degraded observations to unified geometric representations. Additionally, we introduce a joint RGB latent reconstruction task, requiring the model to recover clean RGB information from degraded inputs. This multi-stage strategy effectively decouples environmental style interference, compelling the model to focus strictly on underlying geometric recovery. Extensive evaluations show that OpenDepth sets new SOTA records for robust zero-shot depth estimation across standard and extreme weather benchmarks, demonstrating exceptional structural integrity and adaptability.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 OpenDepth，把开放世界单目深度估计视为跨多种风格图像的一致几何推断，借助 I2I 编辑先验，通过 DiT 浅层特征对齐与联合 RGB 潜变量重建解耦风格干扰，在标准与极端天气基准上刷新零样本深度估计结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「将几何相同但风格不同的输入映射到统一 latent 空间」与辅助 RGB 潜变量重建监督，可能为 LVR 中视觉扰动下的潜状态稳定与几何/任务必要信息保留提供可核查的方法线索，但该工作本身不做推理轨迹或答案使用分析。
